en.title: Practice: Stress in Pairs
en.summary: Practice moving the strong stress to the new ending when saying Romanian word pairs aloud.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs: Every word has one strong beat. Your voice sounds louder and higher on this beat. Listen to (frumos) /fruˈmos/, which means beautiful. The beat lands on the end. When endings change, the strong beat often moves. You feel the rhythm jump to another part.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Open your mouth and push more air on the stressed part. Hold that vowel a little longer. Say word pairs together. Start with (cântă) /ˈkɨn.tə/. Hit the first part with extra force. Now say (cântăm) /kɨnˈtəm/. Push your voice forward and hit the new ending. Feel the beat jump.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: Written Romanian does not use stress marks. You cannot see the beat on paper. When a word adds an ending, the beat often moves. Read word pairs side by side. Train your ears to notice where the loud beat lands each time.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not keep the beat in the same spot. Some learners freeze the stress on the first syllable. This makes words sound flat or wrong. Do not make every syllable equally loud. Relax your mouth on the weak parts. Move the loud beat when the ending changes.
